items.exampleEn: My grandmother lights incense at the temple every New Year.
items.exampleZh: 我奶奶每年過年都會去廟裡點香。

items.exampleEn: The company was criticized for sexism in its job ads.
items.exampleZh: 那家公司因為徵才廣告有性別歧視而受到批評。

items.exampleEn: Some newspapers ask families to write the obituary themselves.
items.exampleZh: 有些報紙會請家屬自己撰寫訃聞。

items.exampleEn: In the past, only the nobility could own land in this country.
items.exampleZh: 過去在這個國家，只有貴族才能擁有土地。

items.exampleEn: The report gives an impartial view of both sides of the debate.
items.exampleZh: 這份報告公正地呈現了辯論雙方的看法。

items.exampleEn: Fans of old cars have created a lively subculture with their own magazines.
items.exampleZh: 老車迷形成了一個熱鬧的次文化，還有自己的雜誌。

items.exampleEn: Some scientists study small sea animals that seem to achieve immortality.
items.exampleZh: 有些科學家研究似乎能長生不死的小型海洋動物。

items.sentenceEn: The smell of incense filled the old temple.
items.sentenceZh: 香的味道瀰漫了整座老廟。

items.audioEn: A good referee must stay impartial, even when his hometown team is playing.
items.audioZh: 好裁判就算家鄉球隊上場，也必須保持公正。
items.questionZh: 家鄉球隊比賽時，好裁判應該怎麼做？

items.sentenceEn: Skateboarding started as a small subculture in California.
items.sentenceZh: 滑板運動一開始是加州的一個小眾次文化。

items.sentenceEn: Sexism in the workplace is still a problem in many industries.
items.sentenceZh: 職場上的性別歧視在許多行業仍然是個問題。

items.stemEn: In the film, a rich man spends his money searching for ____, but he learns that a short life can be happy.
items.stemZh: 在那部電影裡，一個有錢人花錢尋找永生，最後卻明白短暫的人生也能很快樂。

items.stemEn: Judges must be ____ and treat everyone in court the same way.
items.stemZh: 法官必須公正，在法庭上對每個人一視同仁。

items.passageEn: Last week, our local newspaper printed an obituary of Ms. Wu, a painter who lived to ninety-five. She was born into a family of the old nobility, but she chose a simple life. In her twenties, she joined the city's young artists' subculture and painted on the walls of old factories. Later, she spoke out against sexism in the art world, where women's paintings were often ignored. Many people remember her as an impartial judge at art competitions, because she never cared who the artist was. Every morning, she burned incense and sat quietly for an hour before painting. A book about her life later became a bestseller. She once said that art was her only path to immortality.
items.passageZh: 上週，我們的地方報紙刊登了吳女士的訃聞，她是一位活到九十五歲的畫家。她出身舊貴族家庭，卻選擇了簡樸的生活。二十幾歲時，她加入了城裡年輕藝術家的次文化圈，在老工廠的牆上作畫。後來，她公開反對藝術界的性別歧視，因為當時女性的畫作常被忽視。很多人記得她是藝術比賽中公正的評審，因為她從不在乎作品是誰畫的。每天早上，她都會燒香、安靜坐一個小時再開始畫畫。後來，一本關於她生平的書成了暢銷書。她曾說，藝術是她通往不朽的唯一道路。

questions.questionZh: 吳女士年輕時加入了什麼？
options: 年輕藝術家的次文化圈

questions.questionZh: 為什麼很多人記得她是公正的評審？
options: 她從不在乎作品是誰畫的

items.promptZh: 這座城堡以前屬於一個貴族家庭。
referenceEn: This castle once belonged to a family of the nobility.
This castle used to belong to a family from the nobility.
rubricZh: 「貴族家庭」要用到 nobility（例如 a family of the nobility、a family from the nobility 等）
「以前屬於」可寫，例如 once belonged to、used to belong to 等

items.promptZh: 這座城市的街舞次文化吸引了很多年輕人。
referenceEn: The street dance subculture in this city attracts many young people.
Many young people are drawn to this city's street dance subculture.
rubricZh: subculture 指次文化（例如 the street dance subculture 等）
時態可用現在式、過去式或現在完成式（例如 attracts、attracted、has attracted 等）
主動或被動都可以（例如 attracts…、are drawn to… 等）
